name: SIOPE median education investment per student, by year (BRL, nominal)
sql: SELECT year, median_brl_per_student FROM bi.siope_invest_year ORDER BY year

name: SIOPE municipalities reporting, by year
sql: SELECT year, municipalities_reporting FROM bi.siope_reporting_year ORDER BY year

name: SIOPE median investment per student by region, 2024 (BRL)
sql: SELECT region, median_brl_per_student FROM bi.siope_invest_region_2024 ORDER BY median_brl_per_student DESC

name: SIOPE median investment per student by state, 2024 (BRL)
sql: SELECT uf, median_brl_per_student FROM bi.siope_invest_uf_2024 ORDER BY median_brl_per_student DESC
